NM 03私たちについてWhy Nomimatcha

Matcha that comes with a name, a place and a story.

We buy ceremonial matcha straight from tea farms in Japan. No importers and no brokers in between, so you always know who grew it, where and when.

Direct直接

From the farm to your door, with no middlemen.

Open透明

Every tin names its farm, region and harvest.

Ceremonial本物

Real tea to whisk and sip, not an energy drink.

NM 04作り方How to make

Start with an espresso matcha

The preparation for every matcha latte: a small, strong shot of matcha first, then the milk. Here is how we make ours.

  1. 1Add the matcha

    Add the matcha

    Sift 3 g of matcha into a warm bowl.

    Amount 3 g
  2. 2Add hot water

    Add hot water

    Pour in 30 ml of water at 75°C. Hot, not boiling.

    Setting 75°C · 30 ml
  3. 3Whisk

    Whisk

    Whisk in a W motion for about 30 seconds.

    Setting ~30 sec
  4. 4Make it a latte

    Make it a latte

    Pour your espresso matcha over cold or steamed milk.

    Then + milk
  5. 5Share it

    Share it

    Snap a photo and tag us. We love seeing your bowl.

    Tag us @nomimatcha

You will need a bowl (chawan), a bamboo whisk (chasen), a scoop (chashaku) and a small sieve.
